answer: An economy can require each agent to keep proving itself, not just once at signup: every identity must regularly solve small puzzles woven from its own past work, like a plume of smoke that only rises from a real fire. A lone agent on a mesa can manage its own stream, but a Sybil farmer facing a gale of fresh challenges for thousands of fakes must pay compute for every one, continuously. Fakes that stall lose standing and their transactions stop clearing.
